title: A Model of an Environmental Management System for a Mining and Energy Complex Based on Principles of a Reclamation and Sustainable Development
content: Mining and energy complexes have a significant impact on environmental quality through coal mining and combustion. This paper analyses the impact of the ash disposal site of the “Kostolac” mining and energy complex in Serbia. Environmental quality effects of operational activities of the abovementioned complex are ranked according to their significance. The Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is used as the basis for a real assessment of technical and financial capabilities and for the implementation of prescribed environ-mental protection measures at “Kostolac”. The paper outlines a proposed solution environmental issues, based on the Balanced Scorecard (BSC), approach, which contributes to improving the existing environmental management system at “Kostolac” and recover ash and slag dumping sites. The primary contribution of this paper is the definition of environmental management model elements in the mining and energy complex through the application of probability theory, AHP method guidelines, and BSC strategies. It is recommended to utilize an adequate basis for the technical and environmental education of mining and energy complex management in order to mitigate the risk of inadequate management decisions.
